data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'jahana', meaning 'to give' or 'to reward'. In Islamic tradition, the name Juhainah is given to signify the gift of a child or the reward for a righteous life. The name Juhainah carries the meaning “Gift, reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juhainah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
